rationale: I re-hashed the held FR text (sha 66e5d398...) and read all of it. EO 11792 (39 FR 23191, signed 1974-06-25) has one paragraph: under IPA 1970 section 102(a), 'effective July 20, 1974 the Advisory Council on Intergovernmental Personnel Policy is abolished and Executive Order No. 11607 ... is revoked.' It contains no continuing command, no savings clause and no partial scope. My reading is that both operative commands are self-executing, dated acts that were performed on 1974-07-20, so the best reading is that the order has no continuing force (a NO). But the frozen evidence holds only the ORIGINAL and CLAUSES records: no ACT:, TERM: or ACTOR_TEXT: record, and the machine found no own-terms for the order. The kit requires such a record for NO, and a 1989 snapshot row ('Revokes EO 11607') is only a lead and says nothing about the end of 11792 itself. Cruden found no held later instrument citing EO 11792, so there is no later ending to weigh either. No YES: no CURRENT: predicate is held. I therefore leave the status unrecommended and state the exact gap; I do not assert the 1974-07-20 effective date as an accepted interval.
